_meta.source: Observed live, 2026-09-23. 'verified' = captured directly in this session. 'inferred' = structure known but the state could not be produced (needs a second account / populated class).
_meta.idPattern: courseId is an opaque base64-ish string, e.g. NzQxMjM0NTY3ODkw (12-16 chars)

screens.name: App boot / route change
screens.description: Every navigation shows this before data arrives.
elements: Titlebar reduced to: hamburger (greyed), Google apps, avatar — logo and page title absent
4px indeterminate linear progress bar pinned under the titlebar, Google blue segment on a light blue track
Nav drawer shows Home + Calendar, then a centred circular spinner where the class list will be, then Archived classes + Settings
Content area is an empty white panel with a rounded top-left corner
Help FAB is already present bottom-right
screens.cloneNote: Worth reproducing — it is the first thing a learner sees and it sets the perceived speed of the product.

screens.name: Home — first-run onboarding
screens.trigger: First visit to the revamped home

dialog.title: Welcome to the new Google Classroom Home
dialog.body: The revamped homepage helps you stay on top of student work and up to date on the newest tools, features, and resources.

screens.behind: 'Recently due' card renders SKELETON rows: grey circle avatar placeholder + two grey pill bars per row

sections.note: only rendered when the account both teaches and is enrolled; selected segment carries a check icon and #D3E3FD fill

empty.illustration: bird at a laptop with a checklist
empty.title: No recent assignments to review
empty.body: See assignments from the past 7 days that need review

sections.title: Due soon
sections.empty: You don't have any work due in the next 7 days

sections.title: Class learning tools
sections.info: Gems and Notebooks that have been recently posted by your teachers
sections.empty: You don't have any assigned class learning tools

screens.name: Class card
anatomy: banner region ~100px tall: theme image or colour, class name (white, 2-line clamp with ellipsis), section line beneath
teacher avatar / class image overlapping the banner bottom-right, 64px circle, white ring
body: 'No work due soon' + 'Woohoo, no work due soon!' (student) or upcoming item list
footer row separated by a 1px divider: two icon buttons + overflow (⋮)

student: Hide (tooltip: Hide and silence this class.)
Unenroll (tooltip: Removes you from this class.)

screens.name: Class — Stream (populated)
screens.observedOn: an enrolled class with 10+ material posts

condensed.anatomy: leading type icon (book / assignment / help) · '<Author> posted a new <type>: <Title>' · date line · more_vert
condensed.when: class setting 'Classwork on the Stream' = Show condensed notifications (the default)

full.when: announcements, and classwork when the setting is 'Show attachments and details'
full.anatomy: white card, radius 8-12, 1px #DADCE0 border: avatar + author + posted date + '(Edited <date>)' + body + attachment chips + 'Add class comment' row

dateFormats: MMM D, YYYY (Edited MMM D, YYYY)

empty.illustration: bear at a desk with a computer, grey line art
empty.title: This is where you'll assign work
empty.body: You can add assignments and other work for the class, then organize it into topics

structure.heading: Teachers
structure.row: 40px avatar + display name; hovering reveals a ⋮ with 'Remove' for co-teachers

structure.heading: Students
structure.populated: select-all checkbox + 'Actions' menu (Email, Remove, Mute) + count '<n> students'; rows: checkbox, avatar, name, ⋮

empty.title: This is where you'll view and manage grades

populated.structure: spreadsheet grid: sticky first column of students (avatar + name), one column per assignment (title + 'out of N' + due date), sortable; cells accept a grade or show a status chip (Turned in / Missing / Done late / Draft); header row has a per-column ⋮ menu (Copy all grades to..., Sort by, Return all, View submissions)

screens.name: Calendar
elements: Titlebar gains a 'jump to date' calendar icon
Body: one column per day when items exist; blank when the week has none

screens.name: To-do (student)
screens.rows: grouped by due window ('This week', 'Next week', 'Later', 'No due date'); each row = class colour dot, title, class name, due time

screens.name: To review (teacher)
screens.rows: assignment title, class, '<n> turned in / <n> graded', due date

empty.illustration: window, plant and mug, isometric line art
empty.title: None of your classes have been archived
